facts.text: Jolene mentioned that a session about releasing expectations and judgments and savoring the present stood out to her.

evidence.quote: The one session that really stood out was about releasing expectations and judgments and just savoring the present.

facts.text: Jolene expressed that she often becomes too consumed with hitting her goals and forgets to appreciate the journey.

evidence.quote: I usually get too consumed with hitting my goals that I forget to appreciate the ride.

facts.text: Jolene agreed with Deborah that focusing on the big stuff can cause one to miss the tiny wins in life.

evidence.quote: Sometimes we get too focused on the big stuff and don't appreciate all the tiny wins.

facts.text: Jolene noted that small things like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee can make life much better.

evidence.quote: Like the feeling of the sun or a great cup of coffee - can be small but they make life much better.
